policy.cycle_completion: Actual post-gap ACK timestamps span the pinned compression interval, or all bytes from a physically ACK-proved drained flight have applied. Missing old bytes cannot be paid by new arrivals. A fresh post-boundary pair may supersede and retire old incomplete evidence only on controller acceptance.
policy.extra_encoded_carrier_overhead_bound: At most 1% of newly cumulative credited bytes; excludes lower-level TCP/WebSocket framing.
policy.partial_increase: New cycle bytes divided by the full preceding-gap-to-last-ACK interval may raise the hold while keeping the cycle incomplete. Only completed evidence can lower the held rate; no expected-rate byte quota.
policy.quiet_interval: ceil(AckCompressTimeout / 10), with minimum 1 ns for positive timeout; existing immediate behavior for non-positive timeout
policy.storage: Three fixed timestamp/byte summaries plus bounded metadata; existing 64-bucket ring unchanged in size.
